# Bootstrap Icons 1.13.1

Official unmodified CSS, WOFF and WOFF2 fonts from
https://github.com/twbs/icons/tree/v1.13.1/font; MIT license included.

Loaded with Laravel `asset()` from the shared surface layout. Font URLs are
relative to the CSS so `/cabinet` deployments require no special rewriting.
No CDN or frontend build is used at runtime. Decorative icons use the shared
`x-icon` component with `aria-hidden="true"`; controls retain visible text.
